Phil Mead is a proud member of Hamilton College’s class of 1959. Always a music fan, he has recently retired from a successful career in the field of medicine and now devotes even more time to his trombone. Phil speaks fondly of his Hamilton music experience and his current involvement with the Alumni All-Stars.
Phil was interviewed in Clinton, New York on June 1, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming at Hamilton College today for the Jazz Archive. And I’m very pleased to have another Hamilton alum, Phil Mead, class of ’59, here today. Welcome.
It’s good to be here. Thanks for having me.
